reviews.text:
My daughters dog was sick and her vet.was.on vacation. Before heading
to the ER she decided to try to  find an
opening elsewhere.
She was able to get the last available appt at CompleteCare Veterinary Center.
Everyone ,from the receptionist, techs and Dr Rodriguez were wonderful..caring ,patient
Very happy we found them.
Great caring staff

I love this place.  The Drs & staff are awesome!  It's the only place I choose bc iver 16 yrs, the staff knows us and the care is exceptional. They helped my kidney failure cat live an extra 5+ yrs & an FIP rescue 10 yrs & still going, with their guidance & professionalism. They're worth every dime.

I am incredibly disappointed with the experience I had at this clinic. It was painfully obvious that their priority is money, not the well being of the animals. The staff was incredibly rude and dismissive when we tried to ask questions about the care being provided. To make matters worse, they severely overcharged us and even double charged for services and work that weren't even performed. It is heartbreaking to bring your pet to a place for help, only to be treated with such greed and disrespect. I strongly recommend taking your pets somewhere that actually cares about them.
Dr Sam is so wonderful ..kind..and caring. The entire staff is great!
Dr Lucas and her staff are the best. Kind compassionate and knowledgeable.
Dr Rodriguez was amazing with my dog. Very personable doctor, great bedside manner, and very knowledgeable. Much more pleasant experience than previous vet.
Friendly & very caring staff and drs
I love this place, I love the staffs I feel so comfortable bringing my babies in here
Very good

Excellent care for us for the past 20 years. I can only speak for one Dr Sangeorgieo
cause he was the original owner. Dr Lucas is a good doctor and compassionate, my dogs trust her.

I was never really happy with my previous vet, so when my cat started limping I looked for somewhere else to bring him. I picked this office on a whim since it was close to me. I’m so happy that I did! Even from the first phone call to make an appointment I instantly felt more at ease and like they would really care for my cat. They got me in to see a vet the same day. They even called my old vet to have records sent over that same day. Dr. Rodriguez was so kind and helped my cat at that very first appointment. He came up with a treatment plan that worked without pushing anything on me. He answered all my questions patiently. I will definitely be back!

I have been going to my dog was at the age of 2 months he's 12 years old now Dr San Giorgio is the best vet going you would never find another vet by him I was so happy that they opened up again and couldn't wait to get back with my dog I feel very comfortable and at ease when I enter that vet and my dog loves them also they also pleasant and take the time to examine your dog thank you all for coming back

Cannot thank Dr Lucas and Dr Rodriguez for the care and compassion they showed Jasper during his last two years of his 20 year life.  When I had to say goodbye Dr. Rodriguez couldn’t,t have been more caring and compassionate.  I was given his fur and paw prints which I will always treasure.  I also received a sympathy card signed by the entire staff.  I cannot thank them enough and I highly recommend them and their wonderful staff for all of your pet needs.

Compassionate and honest. I took my dog in as she wasn’t herself for 6 hours. Her entire life she hadn’t been sick except those last 6 hours and I found out she had HSA cancer and was passing. Everyone here was kind and caring, gave her a fuzzy blanket to rest on and me time to just be with her in a quiet space. I highly recommend this practice. The front desk was incredible and comforted me as I waited for husband to arrive. The entire staff supported us the entire time and I’m so glad I went to them. They were not our regular vet yet it felt as if I’ve known them for years. They showed great care to our girl. Thanks for the compassion and care on a devastating day.

PROFESSIONAL & COMPASSIONATE - This is the exact type of vet care you want. I have 2 senior dogs, one of which recently received a cancer diagnosis. Dr. Rodriguez and Dr. Lukas were quick to respond, offered amazing support and followed up daily after our dog's surgery. We were so impressed with their level of care. I highly recommend these doctors.

The vet team is all great, including receptionists, vet techs and the vets. They care about the pets, listen to your concerns carefully, and have good availability. I feel comfortable bringing my pup to any of the vets & my dog is pretty chill there too. Couldn’t recommend them enough.
The staff are nice and friendly. Their prices are expensive but the service is excellent.
Great Service excellent Vet Dr. Sangorgio
Dr.Rod is amazing took great care of our boy Cali we love you staff and Dr.Rod

If I could give this place 1 million stars I would I found my dog here and dr Lukas and dr Rodriguez have always looked out for Budrick and made sure he was good. They go above and beyond for all of there clients. I cannot thank them enough for being such trustworthy and understanding vets. Budrick always love coming here and seeing all his besties as well. Thank you for all you guys do 🩷
Absolutely amazing people there. They took care of my cat and we're so nice to me and answered all my questions!
Great service taking my dog there 17 1/2 years still keep going
Dr. Sangiorgio is Great! He loves his job and loves the pets! Everyone is very nice in the office!
My Cavapoo had diarrea for a week. After seeing the doctor, less than 24 hour later he was pooping like normal! I love how clean and friendly everyone was. 10/10

We love all the doctors there. Our dog Bear recently had a cancerous tumor successfully removed. The entire staff was so caring and understanding while we were going through such a difficult time. Even post operation there were countless follow ups from the entire staff. We can’t thank them enough. From the bottom of our hearts we are forever in debt to Lou, Dr Lukas,  Dr Sangiorgio and everyone else working there. We pray they are able to re-establish the practice in the near future.

As far as their parent company goes….
We are beyond livid at Destination Pets for shutting this location. They shut their phones off because they didnt want to hear it from their former customers. What kind of low brow organization treats people that are so committed to helping people and their animals like this. They didn’t even give them a weeks notice to save a nickel.
They are bottom of the barrel and should be ashamed to be in this line of work.
Lisa Lukas is simply the best !
Great doctors and staff.
The staff always make you feel welcome I come from New Jersey  they are the best caretakers anyone can ask for I would not go any where else
Thank you for always taking such great care of our Molly.
Dr.Sangiorgio and his team are the most professional and pet friendly veterinary practice I’ve ever encountered. I would recommend without hesitation!

I took my pup for a nail clipping at this establishment.  My pup has been turned away by several places who would not clip his nails citing he was non cooperative.   Dr. Rodriguez , William and  Liz ensured me they could get it done. I was nervous and concerned it couldn’t happen. To my relief they worked quickly and professionally.  They knew how to calm my pup and work expeditiously to get the job done.  I’m so grateful and relieved to know this place exits with such professional staff. Highly recommend.
Thanks Dr. Stgeorgio for the great work. He is very kindhearted, helpful and humble person. I appreciate for the job well done. Thank you Doctor
Hanna, thank you so much for your kind review.
Great care.   Office staff is attentive.   They are always willing to answer my questions.  My sister has used this vets office for many years.  She highly recommended them and so would I.
Great spot. Doctor was super nice. Gave good advise, we were happy!

Initially, my cat visited the vet and was prescribed antibiotics for an illness. Despite my increasing concern about his worsening condition, I was explicitly advised by a receptionist not to bring him in. Subsequently, he developed a prolapsed anus, leading to an emergency hospital visit. While it's accurate that earlier intervention might have identified an intestinal issue, my contention lies in the choice of antibiotics. I was told, by a non-vet source working at the desk, that my cat likely just needed probiotics, overlooking the severity of his symptoms. Additionally, I had conveyed information about blood in his feces during this period.

As the situation escalated, my cat required a $20,000 life-saving surgery. Despite the significant cost and efforts, he passed away due to complications. This unfortunate outcome, coupled with the failure to address his escalating diarrhea adequately, adds to the distressing aspects of this ordeal. Furthermore, the non-vet person's implication that the intervention might've been missed due to aggression, despite my cat's weakened state during examination, raises concerns about the accuracy of their assessment and makes me wonder if the cat was labeled aggressive (and not an aggressive) due to the race and valid frustration of the owner.
Dr. Lukas is an amazing Vet always attentive and gentle with my Yuki. Has been our vet for over 13 years and she makes our pet feel at ease.Highly recommended.
Best vet ever Dr Rodriguez took care of three of my cats very caring and loving doctor to animals and people ❤️❤️❤️

On August 1, 2024 I had to say goodbye to Chucky. Chucky was my first dog that I’ve had since I was 7 years old and gave me the greatest 16 years of my life. He was my soul dog, my best friend, my entire world. Chucky had a brother Marly who we had to say goodbye to January 10, 2021. I loved both of my boys with my entire heart and hope they’re playing with each other by the rainbow bridge. The point of this post is to thank CompleteCare Vet Center at 1293 Clove road here on Staten Island for everything they’ve done for my Family & I. Although the process of losing Chucky completely wrecked me, I couldn’t have asked for a better vet and staff to help me go through this process. When I had to pick up Chucky’s ashes a few days later the girl at the front said to me that Chucky was such a good boy and saved some of his fur for me and gave me an ink print of his nose. Today I received a sympathy card with hand written notes from the entire staff and more ink prints of his nose and his paw print and it meant the entire world to me. I attached some pictures of Chucky and Marly and of course the note. Thank you CompleteCare🥺❤️.
Dr. Morello and staff were excellent.  They were patient and kind with my dog.  I would definitely recommend them.
It is the best veterinarian in all of New York. They treat all pets with love. They have the best host, the best veterinarians, and the most affordable prices.
